name: Brad Chambers
source:
One of the most popular guys at Tina Koya High, and one of the school's top athletes. He's a gregarious and easygoing student, but a tumultuous home life has made him overprotective of his sister Zoey. Brad is best friends with Eric, and doesn't like Kiyoshi due to his sister's strange attachment to him.
